physicalRun.workflow: System2 Daily Shadow Input Preflight Readonly

diagnosis: CORR-004 correctly proved and closed exact-session history readiness, but its physical workflow emitted only a console summary and no durable per-symbol replay-identity artifact. NC-T01 continuity promotion requires the continuity receipt to bind the exact replay window actually used for the witness; a human-reconstructed or fixture-derived window is not acceptable.

minimumWitnessExport: exact ordered expected session date set OR canonical deterministic digest plus first/last date sufficient for independent readback
selected PIT bar/revision identity sufficient to reproduce sourceHistoryHash
listing/lifecycle exclusion provenance used to derive eligible sessions
requiredHandoff.acceptableExecution: A bounded one-symbol read-only witness export is sufficient; a full-universe rerun is not required solely to produce this handoff.

buildLaneConsumption: Do not infer/recompute the witness date window independently from a later calendar snapshot.
Continuity promotion receipt must match the exported witness replay/session identity exactly.
Merged #825/#826 replay-first validator must reject any symbol/window/hash mismatch.
Physical NC-T01 final receipt must include deterministic typed sourceGenerationRefs covering this witness identity.
reasonNoNewCorrection: CORR-004 acceptance remains valid for its history-readiness scope; the missing durable per-symbol export is a downstream physical-independence evidence requirement rather than a regression in the repaired history gate.
